question: Bangladesh does not share land border with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bangladesh shares its borders with five Indian states, namely West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram.
 
• Sikkim is located in the northeastern part of India and shares its borders with Nepal, Bhutan, and China, but not with Bangladesh.
 
• The border between Bangladesh and India is approximately 4,096 kilometers long.
 
• West Bengal has the longest border with Bangladesh among the Indian states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bangladesh-India Border:**

 
 
• The Bangladesh-India border is the fifth-longest international border in the world.
 
• It is known as the Radcliffe Line, named after Sir Cyril Radcliffe, who was the chairman of the Boundary Commissions for the partition of India.
 
• The border is marked by a fence to prevent illegal immigration and smuggling.
 
• Several rivers flow across the border, including the Ganges and Brahmaputra.
 
 
 
• **Sikkim:**
 
 
• Sikkim is a state in northeastern India, known for its mountainous terrain and biodiversity.
 
• It became the 22nd state of India in 1975.
 
• Sikkim is bordered by the Indian state of West Bengal to the south, Bhutan to the east, Tibet to the north and northeast, and Nepal to the west.
 
• The state capital is Gangtok.
 
 
 
• **Meghalaya:**
 
 
• Meghalaya is a state in northeastern India, known for its heavy rainfall, forests, and biodiversity.
 
• The state capital is Shillong.
 
• Meghalaya shares a 443-kilometer border with Bangladesh.
 
 
 
• **Mizoram:**
 
 
• Mizoram is a state in northeastern India, known for its rolling hills and valleys.
 
• The state capital is Aizawl.
 
• Mizoram shares a 318-kilometer border with Bangladesh.
 
 
 
• **Tripura:**
 
 
• Tripura is a state in northeastern India, known for its diverse culture and heritage.
 
• The state capital is Agartala.
 
• Tripura shares an 856-kilometer border with Bangladesh.
